cues.en: So how does Angular's

that are going on on the page that could potentially lead
to changes that should be reflected on the screen therefore.
For example, if a user clicks a button,
Angular gets notified about that
and then it's change detection process starts
and visits all components in the entire application,
no matter where that click occurred.
It visits all components in the entire application
and takes a look at all the templates there
and all the template bindings,
so all the uses of property binding and string interpolation
and so on and Angular checks whether
that binding now produces a new value,
if it produces a value that's different
from what was visible before.

with that new value.

by default in Angular applications.
